## Existing leggings order terms

- Existing leggings styles: MOQ 5 pieces per style; colors and sizes may be mixed.
- Sampling lead time: 7 working days. Confirm the specification and start date; revisions, bulk production and shipping need their own schedule.
- The 5-piece MOQ is for existing styles, not a blanket minimum for custom designs, materials or branding.
- Published terms and SKU-specific fabric references: https://glorystarwearing.com/custom-leggings-manufacturer/#order-terms

## Evidence policy

- Product-specific fabric, measurements, colors, performance, MOQ, timing and quality requirements are confirmed against the project brief and approved sample.
- Factory ownership, production capacity, certifications, named customers, testimonials and measurable case outcomes are not treated as verified claims unless the relevant dated document, permission or public third-party source is available.
- Images on the site should be treated as product or workflow references unless their provenance and current relevance are verified.
